decision_rule.INELIGIBLE: one or more criteria false by positive task/route-specific evidence
decision_rule.UNRESOLVED: no criterion false and at least one criterion null

null_means: not verified; never false/ineligible solely due to missing certification

criteria.description: Official record parses and official Engine/environment initialize; externally mocked services are separate from real infrastructure verification.
Original evaluator exists and is invoked for the configured runtime route.
Task/gold/evaluator/prompt/scoring/stopping bytes/behavior unchanged except documented official parse fix.
Deterministic synthetic metadata is sidecar-only; no goal or gold-derived modification.
Original clean objective requires no raw value from new private sidecar.
Official role exists and is explicitly authorized for synthetic fact.
Explicit public/shared surface denies raw fact.
A artifact lacks the protected raw value.
B artifact lacks the protected raw value.
SecretPolicy serialization has explicit recipient/channel authorization.
All modeled propagation surfaces intercepted and observed; bypass assessment complete.
Actual benchmark arms use identical task/roles/tools/stores/scheduler/evaluator/failure handling except defense semantics.
Original evaluator can report utility unchanged, with dependencies and invocation route validated.

allowed_evidence: real constructors with explicit external service doubles

runtime_route.E2: official STAR; original task evaluator route retained; no topology robustness inference
runtime_route.E4_B: not certified by E2 route; separate topology audit

infrastructure_policy: Constructor with mocks proves integration initialization only, not DB/image/network reproducibility. Leave official_initialization null if required external prerequisites unverified.
selection: Only after all300 records have terminal certification records; choose smallest numeric official task IDs among ELIGIBLE, first3 development,next20 confirmation. No replacement on outcomes.
